suggestions.title: Test suite timeout investigation — full suite hangs at 300s
suggestions.description: The full unit test suite (`npx jest --testPathPattern='unit/'`) times out at 300s even with --forceExit and maxWorkers=2. Individual subsets (auth/contents/users, emergency/game/notification, learning/ai/orchestrator) all pass. The full run hits a timeout due to accumulated test time + open handles. Consider: (1) splitting into separate CI jobs, (2) investigating open handles with --detectOpenHandles, (3) adding global teardown to close DB connections.

details.symptom: 300s timeout on full suite, but subsets pass
root_cause_candidates: test suites not cleaning up timers/DB connections

suggestions.title: Add --detectOpenHandles to test script for leak diagnosis
suggestions.description: Multiple test suites warn 'A worker process has failed to exit gracefully and has been force exited.' This indicates leaked handles (open DB connections, active timers). Adding --detectOpenHandles to the test script (or as a one-off diagnostic run) would identify which suites have leaks. This is prerequisite for fixing the full-suite timeout.

details.expected_output: stack traces of leaked handles per test suite
details.fix_approach: add globalTeardown to close TypeORM connections, unref() active timers
